skill.summary: Get current public IP address and geolocation information. Use when users ask about IP addresses, network location, or want to check their public IP. Supports both fetching IP info and displaying it clearly.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Expanded list of trigger phrases to recognize more queries about IP address and location.
- Improved clarity in user prompts such as "Where am I?", "Locate me", and "Get location".
- No changes to core functionality or workflow.
